verdict.rationale: vLLM's PagedAttention (vllm-docs-2) and tensor/pipeline/data/expert/context parallelism (vllm-docs-13) give power-users mechanisms to manage KV-cache memory and distribute inference across instances, and community reports (vllm-comm-3, vllm-comm-4) corroborate KV cache/continuous batching as core memory-management tools. However, the evidence pack lacks explicit documentation of configuration knobs (e.g., gpu-memory-utilization, per-instance memory limits, multi-instance orchestration controls) that a power-user would use to directly tune allocation across concurrent instances. Missing for 10: explicit docs on memory-allocation flags/parameters for multi-instance deployments, hands-on confirmation of fine-grained control.
